title: Flight Carrying Israeli Passengers Diverted After Onboard Stabbing
detail: A flight carrying Israeli passengers was diverted after a stabbing incident occurred onboard, according to Al Jazeera's Jerusalem Daily report. Further details on the location, perpetrator, and victims were not immediately available.

title: Israeli Strikes Kill Seven Across Gaza, Including Journalist in Khan Younis
detail: Seven Palestinians were killed in Israeli airstrikes across Gaza on Sep 30, 2026, per medics: a woman in a Gaza City apartment strike targeting a Hamas militant, at least four in a vehicle strike in Tel al-Hawa (14 wounded), local journalist Mohammad al-Najar near a mosque in Khan Younis, and one person in Qarara. Counts of 5-7 dead were reported by different outlets as figures were updated.

media.caption: Gaza rescue efforts amid continued Israeli strikes
